summary: Completed frontend testing for FASE E-8 Wave 1: New roles (sales_admin & finance) with separation of duties. Tested 11 user stories across 4 roles (finance, sales_admin, sales, admin). Backend already verified with 64/64 POC tests.

backend_issues.notes: Backend testing skipped per request - already verified with test_core_e8_roles_poc.py (64/64 passed) and gate.sh (50 gates GREEN)

ui_bugs.issue: Role labels show with bullet prefix: '· Finance' and '· Admin Sales' instead of just 'Finance' and 'Admin Sales'
ui_bugs.evidence: Screenshots show entity-role-tag displays '· Finance' and '· Admin Sales'

frontend_issues.notes: Order detail action buttons are status-dependent and correctly hidden for orders in 'Reserved' status. This is expected behavior, not a bug.

passed_tests: US20-A: Finance lands on finance-tower dashboard (✅ URL contains 'finance-tower', page title correct)
US20-B: Finance has tax invoice action buttons - NSFP (3), Replace (3), Cancel (0) - correct configuration
US20-C: Finance can record payments - 4 payment recording buttons found, modal opens correctly
US14-B: Sales lost payment recording button - 0 payment buttons, 2 follow-up buttons present (correct)
US14-C: Sales lost pegging buttons - 0 pegging buttons, 0 add stock buttons (correct)
US15: Sales Admin has no tax/payment buttons in order detail (0 tax, 0 payment buttons)
US21: Sales Admin entity switching works - can switch between KSC, KANDA, and 'All Entities' mode with read-only warning
LoginScreen: All 6 demo role buttons present (admin, manager, sales-admin, finance, sales, warehouse)
Finance menu visibility: Finance role has finance-specific menus (Dasbor Keuangan, Kas & Bank, AR/Piutang, Pajak) and NO warehouse menus
RoleLabel-SalesAdmin: Shows 'Admin Sales' (with bullet prefix, minor cosmetic issue)
RoleLabel-Finance: Shows 'Finance' (with bullet prefix, minor cosmetic issue)

success_percentage.details: 8 of 11 user stories fully verified. 2 user stories partially verified (US14-A: sales has no orders to test; US21: entity switching works per screenshot but automated test had text matching issues). 1 minor cosmetic issue (bullet prefix in role labels).

items.description: Role badges show '· Finance' and '· Admin Sales' with bullet prefix. Should display 'Finance' and 'Admin Sales' without prefix.
items.suggested_fix: Remove bullet/separator prefix from role label display in entity-role-tag and tour-menu-role-badge

items.description: Cannot fully test US14-A (sales order detail buttons) because sales@kainnusantara.id user has no orders visible. This might be expected if no orders are assigned to this sales user.
items.suggested_action: Verify if this is expected behavior or if sales user should see some orders. If expected, mark as PASS. If not, investigate order assignment/visibility for sales role.

US20_finance_role.US20-C_payment_recording: ✅ PASS - Finance has payment recording buttons (4) in collection tab, modal opens correctly

US14_sales_restrictions.US14-C_inventory: ✅ PASS - Sales correctly missing pegging buttons (0) and add stock button (0)

regression_checks.no_blank_screens: ✅ PASS - All roles land on correct pages with content
